note: Verified reason for every branch of concerto-core src that the unit suite covers but the oracle corpus does not (task P2-11). Keyed <file>:<line>:<branch> as in coverage-gaps.json; bin/coverage-gaps.js merges these into it and reports stale or missing entries. Line numbers are those of the frozen reference and the identical workspace src/.

categories.stub-only: The unit suite reaches the branch only through a sinon stub, a sinon stub instance or a monkey-patched method, forcing a state no object built through the public API can be in. Handed to P2-10 (accordproject/concerto-rust#54).
categories.internal-only: Reached only by calling an internal (@private) method or constructor directly, with arguments no public operation passes. Handed to P2-10.
categories.unrecordable: Reachable through the public API, but only by a call this oracle cannot record by design: an async result, a function argument, a Symbol, a model manager tainted by addDecoratorFactory/updateExternalModels, or an operation whose effect is on the file system. Not stub-only and not P2-10 work: covering it needs a change to the oracle (fixture schema or recorder), which is a coordinator decision.
